# beenfar_wifi_network (Resource)

A wireless network (SSID).

Only the attributes set in the configuration are managed: the others are neither changed by Terraform nor reported as drift, so they can be managed in the beenfar UI. Destroying the resource deletes it entirely.

To leave the access point associations to the UI, do not set `ap_groups`. To manage them from another configuration, use `beenfar_wifi_network_ap_groups` there.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A WPA-personal network on the iot VLAN. ap_groups is not set, so the access
# points that broadcast it are chosen in the beenfar UI and Terraform leaves
# them alone.
resource "beenfar_wifi_network" "iot" {
  ssid         = "iot"
  security     = "wpa_personal"
  security_key = var.iot_passphrase
  band         = "2g"
  network_id   = beenfar_network.iot.id
}

# WPA-enterprise against a RADIUS server.
resource "beenfar_wifi_network" "corp" {
  ssid             = "corp"
  security         = "wpa_enterprise"
  radius_server_id = beenfar_radius_server.corp.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `security` (String) One of `open`, `wep`, `wpa_personal`, `wpa_enterprise`.
- `ssid` (String) Network name, 1-32 bytes; unique.

### Optional

- `ap_groups` (Set of String) Access point groups that broadcast the network; empty means all. Leave unset to manage the associations in the UI.
- `band` (String) Radio bands: `both` (the controller's default), `2g` or `5g`.
- `default_user_group` (String) Default user group.
- `guest` (Boolean) Guest network.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Do not broadcast the SSID.
- `network_id` (String) Id of the `beenfar_network` clients join; empty for the default network.
- `radius_server_id` (String) Id of the `beenfar_radius_server`; required for `wpa_enterprise`.
- `security_key` (String, Sensitive) Pre-shared key for `wpa_personal` (8-63 characters or 64 hex digits) or `wep`. The controller returns it, so a change made in the UI shows as drift.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier. Import uses it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id.
terraform import beenfar_wifi_network.example <id>
```
